title: Station to Station coming to PS5 and Switch 2 on November 26 (Engine Software and Galaxy Grove)

sources.note: Press release, Utrecht 12 Nov 2026: PS5 and Switch 2 on Nov 26, pre-order on Nintendo eShop US $17.99 / EUR 17.99 with 20 percent discount, 54 levels in 7 regions, Creative mode, Mouse Mode with Joy-Con 2 on Switch 2, trailer https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=b1jlcmnTEF8
Gematsu: same date and price; publisher Engine Software, developer Galaxy Grove
Steam appdetails: Galaxy Grove, 48 AED, released Oct 2023, Arabic in supported languages, official trailers
